map.持有 t 年时年化收益率=(1+HPR)^(1/t)−1。上例若持有 2 年，年: With a holding period of t years, the annualized return = (1+HPR)^(1/t) - 1. In the example above, holding for 2 years gives annualized = (1.28)^0.5 - 1, about 13.14%; simply dividing 28% by 2 to get 14% overstates it.
